hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Group all zero-indexed positions where each distinct value appears.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Values that appear once or twice automatically have equal spacing.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: For values with three or more appearances, verify that the difference between every consecutive index pair is identical.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouping indices and verifying difference uniformity takes linear time overall.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning full array for each value takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map stores lists of occurrence indices summing to length n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Collects indices per element and checks step size consistency.
